items.q: where Madame C. J. Walker started her dynasty.

ctx.x: And what years – about what years would that have been?

These would be high school years. This would have been 19 – between 1946 and 1952 or ’53. This was the halcyon years of "The Avenue." Now during the swing years you had this, because Indiana Avenue – or black musicians playing there – this was all the black area over there, where Madame C. J. Walker started her dynasty.
